_schema: Each entry: { id, title, uploadedDate (YYYY-MM-DD), driveUrl, summaryLong, summaryShort (<=4 sentences), child ('Nollen'|'Austin'|'Both'), tags: [string] }. This file is the full-content source of truth for the Documents tab. Activities (schoolItems / activityOptions) may carry a denormalized docRef: { id, summaryShort, driveUrl } pointing back here, so activity cards render without a second fetch. Written by the 'add-to-school-comms' skill.
